notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,

We are getting very close to the full release of Nightrunner, so start your engines, dust off your lofi cassettes and get your wish lists ready!

We thank everyone for their input thus far, and have added the following features, ready for launch:
[list]
[*]  Overdrive Balancing 
[*]  UI improvements
[*]  Bug Fixes
[*]  Tutorial
[*]  More customisation options
[*]  More challenges
[*]  A lives system
[*]  Time rewind mechanic
[*]  General Polish
[/list]

We hope you enjoy your time with Nightrunner, and thank everyone for their opinions. Your input is truly invaluable!

With kind regards,

Planetary Gears
